concept: EBS: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) for DBs needing high, consistent IOPS
tests: Choosing an EBS type for a DB that needs consistently high IOPS, sub-millisecond latency and IOPS independent of size.
expected: Provisioned IOPS SSD io2 / io2 Block Express — IOPS set independently of size, consistently low latency. Triggers: "consistent high IOPS", "sub-millisecond", "provision IOPS independently of capacity", "database".
why_not: gp2 — IOPS tied to size (3 IOPS/GB, burst); st1/sc1 — HDD for sequential throughput and cold data.
